answer: Give every identity a budget of single-use capability permits that attenuate on delegation: split a permit and each half is weaker than the whole, so a farmer can never pool a thousand puppets into one powerful actor, nor clone one honest permit into a thousand useful ones. Permits are earned only by verified prior work, each carrying a cipher of its lineage, like a jade seal stamped by every hand it passed through. The velvet touch: honest permits compound across epochs while a farm's stay flat — multiplication, the farmer's whole edge, is exactly what the system refuses to grant.
